recovery.label: Error Recovery
recovery.title: Recovery Means Making Progress.
recovery.takeaway: Argon and Opus 5.5 recover from early code errors and complete the task. DeepSeek-1017 stops at a partial score of 0.5.
recovery.question: Correction → Progress → Completion
recovery.answer: Argon: error in round 2 → score 0.3 in round 3 → 1.0 in round 8. Opus 5.5 finishes in round 7; DeepSeek-1017 remains at 0.5.

sequence.label: Goal Progress
sequence.title: More Motion. Less Progress.
sequence.takeaway: Argon completes five goals with 475 action submissions; Opus 5.5 does so with 338. Gemini 3.8 Flash completes none with 501.
sequence.question: Actions ≠ Completed Goals
sequence.answer: Argon: 5/5 goals · 475 actions · 18 model calls. Opus 5.5: 5/5 · 338 · 18. Gemini 3.8 Flash: 0/5 · 501 · 36.

drawer.label: Task Completion
drawer.title: A Valid Action Can Still Miss the Goal.
drawer.takeaway: Argon opens the drawer in 13 rounds, recovering after a round-10 error. Sol reaches 24 rounds without completing the task.
drawer.question: Call Accepted ≠ Task Complete
drawer.answer: The native drawer check succeeds for Argon and Fable 5.1, after 13 and 20 rounds respectively; Sol reaches its round limit.

goal.label: Goal Conditions
goal.title: The Whole Instruction Matters.
goal.takeaway: Argon reaches all three goal conditions in six rounds. DeepSeek-1017 ends with one of three after eight.
goal.question: Partial Progress ≠ Completion
goal.answer: Argon moves from 1/3 goal conditions in round 5 to 3/3 in round 6. The instruction requires the cleaned soap bar in the bathtub.

time.label: Time & Decisions
time.title: Fewer Decisions Can Take Longer.
time.takeaway: Argon reaches the chair in 17 rounds; DeepSeek-1017 needs 65. Their elapsed times are much closer than their decision counts.
time.question: Decisions ≠ Elapsed Time
time.answer: Argon: 17 rounds / 437 s. DeepSeek-1017: 65 / 406 s. Astra: 18 / 471 s. Read both decision count and elapsed time.

horizon.label: Budget Limits
horizon.title: Time Is Not the Only Limit.
horizon.takeaway: No model completes this toolbox task. Argon stops at its token limit after 17 model responses, well before the time ceiling.
horizon.question: Time · Tokens · Rounds
horizon.answer: Argon records 603,393 input + output tokens against a 640,000-token ceiling. Its next round is blocked by the token guard; the native goal remains incomplete.

precision.label: Contact Precision
precision.title: Motion Is Not Successful Contact.
precision.takeaway: Argon stops at its token limit with the charger 15.9 cm from the goal. Qwen-Max reaches 400 native steps without insertion.
precision.question: Motion ≠ Successful Contact
precision.answer: Argon: 23 native steps · 15.9 cm final goal distance · token limit. Qwen Max: 400 native steps · no successful insertion.
